sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of tiratricol during breastfeeding. Because it is 99% bound to plasma proteins, the amount in milk is likely to be low. If a mother requires tiratricol, it is not a reason to discontinue breastfeeding. Consider monitoring the breastfed infant’s T3 level.
